description: Mapa de energía y telecomunicaciones de la ciudad de Barcelona is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. WMS service that generates the cartography of the Energy and Telecommunications Map that covers the territory of Barcelona's city council. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. The portal shows the English title as "Map of energy and telecommunications of the city of Barcelona" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. Its keywords include Servicio geográfico, Geoservicio, Energía, Alt Valor, Telecomunicaciones, Mapa. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
